$comment: Facebook Live to a Facebook Page (flag facebook-live, requested feature, on; docs/plan/2026-11-27-facebook-live-ig-live-x-posting.md section 1). The facebook sink is added to the live plan in effect, fed from the H canvas. It binds to the shared H rung that already feeds Twitch/Kick when that rung passes every Facebook limit in data/platforms/facebook.json (the validator decides); otherwise this rung is added (GPU-scaled from the H canvas, the plan's own H encoder and options). bitrate 6000 kbps: the shared Twitch/Kick value, inside Facebook's 1080p60 range of 4,500-9,000 kbps. Audio is the plan's one shared track (encoded once). The target names Credential Manager targets only: the server address and key come from the live video Ujwalam creates at each Go live (secure_stream_url) and are deleted at stream end. priority 6: shed before the YouTube and Twitch/Kick streams, after Instagram (7).
